briefing: NASDAQ jumped +2.6% and the S&P 500 +1.8% in a broad risk-on session, but with only $89.29 in cash we don't have enough dry powder to responsibly fund a new position even among strong candidates like DORM and PFE. Held positions look healthy given the overall +36.6% portfolio gain, so we're holding everything as-is and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage the existing 7 positions.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on hand and ready to invest. Even on a strong risk-on day with attractive momentum candidates available, having too little dry powder ($89.29 here) means you can't take advantage of the opportunity — a reminder that cash management matters as much as stock selection.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指隨時可動用嘅現金儲備。即使今日市況造好、出現唔少具吸引力嘅動能股候選，但手頭現金太少（僅89.29美元），亦難以把握機會——呢個提醒我哋現金管理同揀股一樣重要。

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with the NASDAQ up 2.6% and the S&P 500 up 1.8%, a classic risk-on move where investors rotate into growth and momentum names. Several screened candidates like DORM and PFE showed clean bullish setups (MACD crossovers, price above SMA-20, and in DORM's case a volume surge), reflecting broad participation rather than an isolated spike. No specific news catalysts were available in today's feed, so the move appears driven by general market sentiment rather than a single headline.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍造好，納指升2.6%，標普500升1.8%，屬於典型的「風險偏好」（risk-on）行情，資金流向增長及動能股。多隻篩選名單中的股票如DORM、PFE均出現看漲訊號（MACD黃金交叉、股價高於20日均線，DORM更伴隨成交量放大），顯示升勢由多隻股份帶動，並非單一股份炒作。今日未有具體新聞來源可供引用，故是次升勢較大機會由整體市場情緒帶動，而非個別消息刺激。
